summary: Requires each electrical corporation to file transmission-and-distribution and generation service tariffs for data centers. The generation tariff must make data centers pay incremental generation cost increases for at least 10 years, with non-completion and early termination fees, upfront collateral or prepayment, and a minimum payment based on projected load. The CPUC sets the minimum peak demand threshold, which may not exceed 25 MW; CCAs and electric service providers must adopt parallel tariffs by January 1, 2028 under the same 25 MW cap.

source.citation: AB 2383, Chapter 435, Statutes of 2026 (chaptered text, LegiScan mirror)

notes: Exempts publicly funded research, public safety, publicly funded national security, publicly owned and utility facilities from the generation tariff.
